howTo.label: Getting Started
howTo.title: Simple as 4 step.
howTo.step1Desc: Log in with your GitHub account. No sign-up needed — get started instantly.
howTo.step2Desc: Your tier is automatically calculated based on your contributions over the last year. View it on My Page.
howTo.step3Desc: Pick your background color and card style — changes are saved automatically and applied to your README badge.
howTo.step4Desc: Copy your badge tag with the Copy Tag button and paste it into your GitHub README. Once it's there, your tier updates automatically as you contribute.

noticeData.title: Auto-Update, Account Deletion, and Security Improvements
noticeData.content:
Your README tier badge now updates automatically.

What's new:
- Automatic badge updates (your contributions are reflected without visiting My Page)
- Badge settings are saved automatically (the Save button has been removed)
- Account deletion (available from your profile on My Page; your data is deleted immediately)
- New Privacy Policy page

Security improvements:
- Contributions are now fetched on the server, so tiers can no longer be manipulated.
- The database can now be accessed only from our servers.

Contribution counts now match the number shown on your GitHub profile, so some users may see a slightly different count.
Badges already in your README keep working as they are.

noticeData.title: Dark Theme Applied
noticeData.content:
Dark theme has been applied to the Notice and My Page.

Changes:
- Notice page dark theme applied
- My Page profile card dark theme applied
- Tier creation area dark theme applied
- Tier controller (type/text/background settings) dark theme applied
- Color picker dark theme applied

The entire page now has a unified dark theme for a cleaner look.

noticeData.title: Git TIERS Renewal
noticeData.content:
The Git TIERS page has been completely redesigned.

What's new:
- Full landing page redesign (dark theme)
- Scroll-driven tier progression animation
- Improved tier image design
- My Page UI improvements
- Notice page redesign
- Korean/English language support
- Security enhancements (token protection, server-side API migration)
- Image generation changed to SVG (always crisp, no more blurry images)

We will continue to improve the service.
Thank you for your continued interest and support.

noticeData.title: Function update information
noticeData.content:
